svg.title: Interrupt matrix
svg.desc: Animated interrupt controller: eight sources, each with a status bit and enable bit combined by an AND gate, then OR'd into a single irq output. Shows sticky latching, masking, write-1-to-clear, and level sources ignoring write-1.
svg.text: irq = OR over i of ( IRQ_STATUS[i] & IRQ_ENABLE[i] )
bad stop bit on a frame
bits 0–3 STICKY: latched by an event pulse, cleared only by writing 1 (a same-cycle new event wins over the clear)
bits 4–7 LEVEL: live mirror of a FIFO condition — writing 1 has no effect; change the condition to clear it
A pending but disabled source (“masked”) never drives irq. Reset: IRQ_ENABLE = 0, sticky bits cleared, IRQ_STATUS = 0xC0 (TX FIFO empty).
